answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 88 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 13 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 88 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 456 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the velvet here is verification, the zephyr of cost is what stops the farm, and the jetty of the record keeps every claim checkable.
